title: Pending-Period Billing Terms under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
While a Medical Assistance application is pending, two amounts run on a resident's case: the estimated patient pay billed to the resident each month, and the Medicaid-pending balance that accrues while the outcome is open. The settings that govern them are the same on all six tiers of Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage.

| Setting | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Due day of the month for estimated or actual patient pay | the 10th day of the service month |
| Late charge on patient pay | none — no late charge is assessed on patient pay |
| Rate at which the Medicaid-pending balance accrues | the private daily rate of the occupied room |
| Period for which the pending balance accrues | the calendar month |
| Pending balance held from collection, late charges and nonpayment discharge while the application is pending | yes |
| Reconciliation window after the approval notice | 30 calendar days |
| Basis of the reconciliation | the actual patient pay for each month less the estimates paid for it |

**Terms in plain words.**

1. Patient pay for a service month, whether estimated or actual, is due on the 10th day of that month, and no late charge is ever added to it.
2. The pending balance accrues month by month, by calendar month, at the private daily rate of the room the resident occupies.
3. While the application is pending, the pending balance is held: it is not collected, carries no late charge and is not a ground for a nonpayment discharge.
4. After approval, estimated months are reconciled to the actual patient pay of each month within 30 calendar days of the approval notice.
